_about: Bot v2 rules, all in one place (Taylor's season settings). Ids are discovered from the API; nothing here is season-specific except the rules themselves. Prices are coin, volumes are units per turn.

ship_trade._about: Oct 13 (Taylor: diversify): auto ships also carry goods we neither make nor use when the spread pays (buy at home -> sell there, buy there -> sell at home). Only goods with no other orders at home and none held. Margin 6%, home buys capped at 3% of cash a turn per ship. Off = false.
ship_trade._off_oct15: Taylor Oct 15 (get back on track): off. Trade lots made ~+300 over two days before crew costs; Flax Wyrm ran at crew 0.2 (~20/turn) and traded nothing. Ships sit at crew 0 (no cost).

live._about: items bot v2 runs live (v2/act.py at :50); every v1 writer skips them (v2_owned.py). Empty = v2 only plans. An item v2 suspends itself goes to state/v2/suspended.json and back to v1.

live._ships_about: ships v2 watches (live.ships): one that costs crew for 3 turns in a row while its route trades nothing is paused (crew 0). ship_modes {id: 'auto'}: v2 also sets that ship's route orders and crew every run from this turn's world prices (v2/ships.py).

Flax Wyrm -> Rouhomme (368: candles 74, furniture 13.7, pasties 15.2; beer/cloth exports when they beat home). Unpin = delete the entry.

labour._about_buffers: Oct 14 (Taylor): perishables are never over-bought; labour, porterage, fish and meat are bought to the projected need exactly (planner).

chain._about: intermediates we make ourselves: keep this many turns of the next step's use, never sell below
chain._about_budget: v2/chain.py: the chain may lean on this much bought labour a turn after everything else (banquet, park, quarry, ropewalk, camp, brewery, household duty, build sites) is funded; over it, sewing and weaving are cut first
chain._recovery_oct15: Taylor Oct 15 (get back on track): fill_cash_min 20000 = no buffer top-ups under 20k cash (HOLD: make only what is used); extra_thread_min 100000 = the ropewalk's thread is spun for directly instead of carved out of weaving (the labour budget now picks what gets cut: sewing first, never the rope/net-duty thread)

stockpiles._about: held on purpose (church contracts, prestige builds, gear slots); target units

prestige._about: coin per prestige of every sink is computed live (v2/prestige.py); agreed = the permanent purchases v2 may make on its own, up to to_level (costs from the game tables)

builds._about: full construction materials per building type (overrides the game data). The build manager scales them by (1 - progress) and buys only the shortfall once; labour is metered per turn once the rest is covered.

diagnose._about: v2/diagnose.py self-diagnosis rules R1-R5 (Oct 14, Taylor: yes). Runs in v2/act.py after the store rows. on=false switches it off; coin_per_prestige_cap: the most a prestige slot's good may cost per prestige point it gives (R1).

planned_recipes._about: building type -> recipe diagnose R3 starts (at 0.5, storehouse provider) when a finished building sits idle 2+ turns

ship_church._about: v2/ships.py: ships buy church-ask goods nobody sells at home (tapestries, windows) up to keep, so contracts.py fills the next ask on sight. Off until Taylor says (a full stock is ~9k, over the 20%-of-funds line). prestige_per_unit = the ask's bonus / volume seen (tapestries 175/7, windows 150-175/6).

ship_stock._about: Oct 18 (Taylor: get on track): v2/ships.py buys these where a pinned/auto ship's route town sells them, up to keep, valued at prestige_per_unit x value_per_prestige (must beat price + shipping). furniture: church furniture asks (120 for +75, seen 4x since Oct 9) + the household slot; candles: the luxury slot (3 prestige for 1.5 a turn); pasties: basic food 1.3 vs bread 0.3 (+bread saved). Own cash floor and budget (spend_share of cash a turn, per ship).
